correctness.rationale: The selfadjoint Hilbert-Schmidt kernel yields a reflected ODE for any nonzero eigenfunction; the endpoint condition is the cotangent equation, monotonic intervals exhaust all roots, and direct substitution verifies the converse. Differentiating Kf=0 gives the entire nullspace. A positive root defines the Doob h-transform; its unitary conjugation to K/lambda0, exact signed-root ordering and spectral theorem establish sharp contraction. Endpoint root limits give 4a/pi and 1/3. Numerical checker independently reproduced 14,206 supplementary assertions; no finite check is used as infinite proof.
